An update runs it again with the image and the title update; no update-only command found. It registers an uninstaller in Windows; saves, profiles and settings stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%\TTT2Recomp. setup.notes: installer/Setup.cs runs its embedded installer/dcme_install.py with -DiscPath, -InstallPath, -Lang en|ru and the switches -SkipPrereq, -NoShortcut, -RecompZip <zip> (parse_args: also -KeepBuildTree, -RemoveTools, -DryRun, -Toolchain); DinoCrisisME_Setup.exe itself takes no arguments (Main()), so there is no unattended install of the downloaded program. An update runs the setup again with the disc image.

apps.name: Street Fighter Alpha 3
apps.source: Setup: README.txt: SFA3-Setup.exe converts the player's disc image into an install folder of their choice; its help: 'SFA3-Setup --update FOLDER [--full]' updates an install. Seen on an install into game\ (2026-11-05): the final link fails with Windows' 'file name or extension is too long' (339 objects with absolute paths, about 39,500 characters, over the 32,767 limit) when the folder path is that long. Installed into a short folder and then moved to game\, sfa3.exe plays (its data\ next to it; data\install.json and disc_path.txt keep the old absolute paths). User data: runtime strings (lib\libsfa3rt.a): memory card <data>\vmu_a1.bin, settings <data>\..\sfa3.cfg; seen in that install.

setup.notes: SFA3-Setup.exe help (strings of its PyInstaller payload, 2026-11-05): '--convert IMAGE FOLDER [PSP-IMAGE]' is the conversion without the window (optional PSP image of SFA3 MAX adds characters); '--update FOLDER [--full]' updates an install without the disc image, --full does everything again. The image is .gdi, .cue/.bin or .chd of the USA release. The final link fails ('file name or extension is too long') when the install folder path is long, as inside Quiver's Apps folder: install into a short folder (C:\sfa3) and move it to game\; the same applies to --update. Not verified: whether a folder junction with a short path avoids it.
setup.updateProblem: Inside Quiver's Apps folder the path is too long for its final link step (Windows 'file name or extension is too long'): move game\ to a short folder (C:\sfa3), run SFA3-Setup.exe --update C:\sfa3 there and move it back.

apps.name: WET

setup.notes: WetSetup.exe (strings, 2026-11-05) clones the source into game\wet-recomp (git checkout --force main, or of a release) and runs 'python -u tools\build.py --iso <image>' there (the image only the first time; build.py also takes --toolchain auto|mingw|clang-cl, --jobs N, --debug); the result is game\wet-recomp\build\runtime\WetLauncher.exe. The first build takes 10-30 minutes; its log is setup.log. An update runs WetSetup.exe again (it fetches the newer code and builds without the image); no option of its own found.

setup.notes: installer\cli.py (shipped, 2026-11-05): 'python -m installer --base FILE --update FILE --keys FILE [--dlc FILE ...] --lang CODE --dest DIR [--root DIR] [--temp DIR] [--verify]'; {Image} is the base game XCI or NSP, {UpdateNsp} the 2.0.0 update, {Keys} prod.keys. On a folder with xcx-install.json only --dest is needed (resume, or update with a newer release). JSON events on stdout; exit 0 done, 1 failed, 2 bad command line, 3 cancelled.
